declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Motion timing must reference an --ap-duration-* / --ap-transition-* token so prefers-reduced-motion can collapse it. Use var(--ap-transition-quick|default|slow|emphatic) instead of inline 0.15s/0.2s/0.3s values. See .claude/rules/frontend.md → Motion & prefers-reduced-motion. Audit ref: PLATFORM-VISUAL-AUDIT-2026-05-24.md §2.7 / P2 #19. To opt out for an unavoidable inline value, prepend the declaration with: // stylelint-disable-next-line declaration-property-value-disallowed-list
